faq: Can I pay with a US card?
Yes. Prices are in US dollars and the deposit link takes US cards.
Are flights included?
Only if you want them. We quote land only (the resort, the airport pickup, the days out) or add flights from the US.
Is the resort price per person?
Yes. The from-price is per person a night, two people sharing a room, all inclusive.
What if a resort is closed?
We check before we quote. Closed and reopening resorts are on our resort status page, and we suggest the closest match.
Who meets me at the airport?
Your driver, at the arrivals exit with a sign with your name. We track your flight, so a delay doesn't mean a missed pickup.

special.title: However the family does it.
items: Staying with family?
We still do the airport pickup and the days out, and a weekend at a resort when everyone needs a break.
The whole family on one quote
Different flights, different rooms, one person keeping track. Tell us who's coming and we put it together.
Christmas and summer
The busiest weeks of the year, and some resorts price them higher. The earlier you ask, the more choice there is.
Ten rooms or more?
A wedding or a reunion that size gets group rates. Our Groups page has the details.

faq: Can you pick us up in Kingston?
Yes. Kingston (KIN), Montego Bay (MBJ) and Ocho Rios (OCJ).
We're staying with family. Can you still help?
Yes. Airport pickups go to any area, not just resorts, and the days out and day passes work from anywhere.
Is Christmas more expensive?
At some resorts, yes. Christmas and summer are the busiest weeks, so ask early and we show you what's open and what it costs.
How big is a group?
Ten rooms or more gets group rates. Our Groups page has the details.
Is the resort price per person?
Yes. The from-price is per person a night, two people sharing a room, all inclusive.

faq: ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta de EE. UU.?
Sí. Los precios están en dólares y el enlace del depósito acepta tarjetas de EE. UU.
¿Incluye vuelos?

currency.note: House rates for the £ / C$ switch, set 26 Sep 2026 from the bank table she sent (J$ per unit: US$ sell 160, GBP sell 216.4641, CAD sell 115.1680). Cross rates 0.739 and 1.389, plus about 4% so card conversion doesn't eat the margin. Prices are rounded up to the whole pound or dollar. The bank's buy-side cross (0.807, 1.505) is the fallback if pounds or Canadian dollars are paid into the J$ account instead.
